title: Conjugacy Distinguished Cosets in Hyperbolic $3$-Manifold Groups
summary: A subset $S$ of a group $G$ is \emph{conjugacy distinguished} if the union of all conjugates of $S$ is closed in the profinite topology on $G$. We prove that if $M = \mathbb{H}^3/Γ$ is a hyperbolic $3$-manifold of finite volume, $g \in Γ$, and $H$ is an abelian subgroup of $Γ$, then the coset $gH$ is conjugacy distinguished in $Γ$.
